body:
#### PR description:

Title says it all, some forward-looking changes in preparation for the reworked benchmark scripts https://github.com/cms-patatrack/patatrack-scripts/pull/61. 

#### PR validation:

Running any Phase-2 configuration (that enables the `FastTimerService`) now correctly produces `resources.json` instead of `Phase2Timing_resources.json`

Note: this PR needs to be tested together with https://github.com/cms-sw/cms-bot/pull/2828 to keep the bot's timing tests functional
title: Rename `Phase2Timing_resources` to `resources`
